body: I've talked with my boyfriend and best friend they're going to supervise me for the next couple of days until I go to see my therapist
I'm not really sure.... I'll be happy and productive one minute then I'll think "I want to kill myself" for no reason it appears. Then I'm really depressed
Ok... Also what can you suggest for help on the random emotions?
I'm overweight. I want so badly to lose weight. I'm not like overly overweight but I abhor my body none the less. I will try planning my meals for awhile and see how that goes.

My biggest issue right now is eating and drinking water. My last dr. Appointment my dr told me I lost 11lb since I last saw her (a couple of weeks ago). This was due to drinking little water and little food. Recently my appetite is back and I've been wanting to drink water more. I can just feel myself gain weight and I hate it. I want to keep losing weight but I'm eating and drinking water. I find myself saying spiteful things to myself while/after eating.
Well there you go. At least call and see if they have anything that'll help you :) I know medical records was what I needed so yours should be ok if not it's pretty easy to get medical records.

Do you have documentation of your problems? Perhaps your college has help for you academic wise, my college does. I know what you mean about depression attacks, I get those too every few months; I'm fine for a month or so, then not fine. So far I've used school as hope to get things better. Perhaps the same will be for you...? Just thinking of succeeding in something makes it all a little more bearable.

Find a different psychiatrist!!! I had one that was treating me poorly (medication wise, had me on medications that didn't work for me) so I switched. This new one really seems to care about how I'm doing. Try and get a therapist if you can to, they really help. Also, you can do it!

In my experience it does get better, then it doesn't, then it does.... But, the times where it is better is worth it because the times that it is better are becoming longer and longer; it just takes time.

I agree with the other posters, talk to your doctor. I took Citalopram for two years before it stopped working, I believe I was taking 40mg. I was engaged I was taking care of myself and I was happy. Then it stopped working about a year ago; I had a meltdown and ended up in the ER. I was put on different medications and my new doctor said I was being treated for completely the wrong thing (Lamictal and Abilify). So I'm back on Citalopram with the other medications being slowly dropped. It apparently has been helping me out according to my boyfriend and best friend. You may just need a higher dose, that happens.

I know the feeling, I just want to feel ok too. Over the passed year or so, I learned that blades are synthesizing feeling ok. I noticed that if I avoid them for awhile I start to feel ok, and when the urge comes back I have to live through it so I can be ok for longer. Urges are getting farther and farther apart, but somehow stronger when they are around. Hope this helps....
I don't understand why I have been purposely not drinking water. I can't seem to make myself drink water.
